title: Security review of Grafana dashboard reorganization
summary: Reviewed Grafana dashboard JSON refactoring from templated generic dashboard to organization-specific hardcoded files. Analysis confirmed no security vulnerabilities: files contain pure dashboard configuration (no executable code), datasource UIDs are not secrets, template variables are safely URL-encoded by the plugin, and SQL annotation fields are inert placeholders. The change reduces attack surface by removing a user-input textbox variable previously appended to GitHub queries.
highlights: Datasource UIDs (afnna11mszsowf, afnnbejskioe8a) are Grafana identifiers documented in README—not secrets
Template variables ($repository, $branch, $milestone) are safely URL-encoded by grafana-github-datasource plugin; no SQL/shell/eval sinks
SQL annotation fields (SELECT extract...) are inert placeholders from Grafana UI; GitHub datasource does not evaluate them
Removal of $extra textbox variable reduces injection surface by eliminating user input previously appended to GitHub search queries
No auth/RBAC changes, credentials, HTML sinks, CI trust changes, or parsing differentials introduced
